name: A Transitional Eve
source:
New Year's Eve is truly a time for many types of transitions. A group of friends undergoes one.

[From [url=https://dagitabsoft.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]the developer's blog[/url]]
translation:
跨年夜确实是各种转变发生的时刻。一群朋友，也正在经历其中的一种。

（摘自[url=https://dagitabsoft.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]开发者的博客[/url]）
